# Kathleen Defever for Tiburon Town Council

> Kathleen Defever is a candidate for Tiburon Town Council in the 2026
> general election. She has served on the Tiburon Planning Commission
> since 2018, is President of the Rotary Club of Tiburon-Belvedere, and
> a Board Member of Farley Place, an affordable senior community serving
> Tiburon and Belvedere.

- [Home](https://defeverfortowncouncil.com/): Overview, campaign tagline, and top priorities.
- [Endorsements](https://defeverfortowncouncil.com/endorsements): Local leaders and elected officials endorsing the campaign.
- [Priorities](https://defeverfortowncouncil.com/priorities): Kathleen's platform for Tiburon Town Council.
- [About](https://defeverfortowncouncil.com/about): Kathleen's record of service, personal story, and photos.
- [Journey](https://defeverfortowncouncil.com/journey): Timeline of Kathleen's public service in Tiburon.
- [Education & Qualifications](https://defeverfortowncouncil.com/achievements): Kathleen's education, qualifications, and memberships.
- [Donate](https://defeverfortowncouncil.com/donate): Contribute to the campaign.
- [Contact](https://defeverfortowncouncil.com/contact): Get in touch with the campaign.
